run_REINFORCE_training: run the REINFORCE reinforcement learning algorithm with configurable environment and agent creation functions
create_REINFORCE_instance: create a Reinforce instance with config, environment factory, and agent factory to set up training
compute_REINFORCE_loss: compute the REINFORCE loss including baseline loss, entropy loss, and policy gradient from trajectories
extract_model_state_dict: extract a PyTorch model state dict and move all tensors to a specified device
review_REINFORCE_run_loop: review the main training loop that alternates between trajectory collection, loss computation, and model updates
